# Libraries and packages

Load our custom functions for running LOESS+DE-SWAN and investigating simulation results.

```{R}
source("../utils/loess_utils.R")
```

Load other libraries.

```{R}
library(cluster)
library(dplyr)
library(gplots)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

```{R}
set.seed(1989)
uniform_ages = runif(n=200,min=21,max=70)
gaussian_ages = rnorm(n=200,mean=50, sd=8)
gaussian_mixture_ages = c(rnorm(n=100,35,6),rnorm(n=100,65,6))
ipop_data = read.csv("../ipop_data_analysis/nonlinear_aging_data/sample_info.csv")
ipop_ages = ipop_data$adjusted_age
```

# Heatmaps of raw and smoothed null data

Generate omics data.

```{R}
set.seed(1213)
uniform_data = generateOmics(uniform_ages, 
                             npred=1000, 
                             distribution="standard_normal")
gaussian_data = generateOmics(gaussian_ages, 
                              npred=1000,
                              distribution="standard_normal")
gaussian_mixture_data = generateOmics(gaussian_mixture_ages, 
                                      npred=1000,
                                distribution="standard_normal")
ipop_data = generateOmics(ipop_ages, 
                          npred=1000,
                          distribution="standard_normal")
```

Function to make heatmaps.

```{R}

my_colors = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(99) 

makeHeatmaps = function(data,dist,main_title ="",outfile="plot.jpeg")
{
  jpeg(paste0(outfile,"_raw.jpeg"),width=6,height=6,units="in",res=300)
  # note that heatmap.2 calls the hclust which defaults to complete
  # linkage and the dist function which defaults to Euclidean
  heatmap.2(as.matrix(t(data[[1]][,-1])),
            trace="none",
            Rowv=T,
            Colv=F,
            col=my_colors,
            breaks = seq(-4,4,length.out=100),
            labCol =NA,
            labRow = NA)
    title(main_title, line = -3, cex.main=3, adj=0.55)
  dev.off()
  jpeg(paste0(outfile,"_clustered.jpeg"),width=6,height=6,units="in",res=300)
  heatmap.2(as.matrix(t(data[[2]][,-1])),
            trace="none",
            Rowv=T,
            Colv=F,
            breaks = seq(-2,2,length.out=100),
            col=my_colors,
            labCol = NA,
            labRow = NA)
  title(main_title, line = -3, cex.main=3, adj=0.55)
  dev.off()
}
```

Make the heatmaps.

```{R}
makeHeatmaps(data = uniform_data, dist = "uniform", main_title = "Uniform", outfile = "figs/uniform_heatmap")
makeHeatmaps(data = gaussian_data, dist = "gaussian", main_title = "Gaussian", outfile = "figs/gaussian_heatmap")
makeHeatmaps(data = gaussian_mixture_data, dist = "gaussian_mixture", main_title = "Gaussian\n Mixture",
             "figs/gaussian_mixture_heatmap")
makeHeatmaps(data = ipop_data, dist = "ipop", main_title = "iPOP",
             "figs/ipop_heatmap")
```

# Age density plots

Add the bottom row, which shows the age densities.

```{R}
p1 = ggplot(data = data.frame("age"=uniform_ages), 
       aes(x=age)) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..),color="black",fill="white") +
  ggtitle("Uniform") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0,0.055) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5))

p2 = ggplot(data = data.frame("age"=gaussian_ages), 
       aes(x=age)) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..),color="black",fill="white") +
  ggtitle("Gaussian") + 
  theme_minimal() +
    ylim(0,0.055) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5))

p3 = ggplot(data = data.frame("age"=gaussian_mixture_ages), 
       aes(x=age)) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..),color="black",fill="white") +
  ggtitle("Gaussian Mixture") + 
  theme_minimal() +
    ylim(0,0.055) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5))

p4 = ggplot(data = data.frame("age"=ipop_ages), 
       aes(x=age)) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..),color="black",fill="white") +
  ggtitle("iPOP") + 
  theme_minimal() +
    ylim(0,0.055) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5))

p1 | p2 | p3 | p4
ggsave("figs/age_densities_loess_example.jpeg",width=12,height=3)
```

# Cluster trajectories

Function for plotting cluster trajectories.

```{R}
plot_clusters = function(loessed_df, k,
                         ymin = -2, ymax=2)
{
  clust_df = t(loessed_df[,-1])
  df_hclust = hclust(dist(clust_df),method="complete") # default for dist is Euclidean
  clusters = cutree(df_hclust,k=k)
  for(i in 1:k)
  {
    cluster_data = loessed_df[,-1][,which(clusters == i)]
    centroid = apply(cluster_data,1,mean)
    plot(loessed_df$ages, centroid,
          xlab = "age", ylab = "molecule level",
         type="l", cex.axis = 1.5, cex.lab=1.25,
         ylim=c(ymin,ymax)) #c(min(cluster_data),max(cluster_data)))
    for(j in 1:ncol(cluster_data))
    {
      lines(loessed_df$ages, cluster_data[,j],lwd=0.3,col="grey")
    }
    lines(loessed_df$ages, centroid,
          lwd=3,col=rainbow(k)[i])
    title(paste0("n = ", ncol(cluster_data)), line=-2,cex.main=2)

  }
}
```

Plot trajectories for all four of the age distributions.

```{R}
jpeg("figs/uniform_trajectories_yscale2.jpeg",width=6,height=6,units="in",res=300)
par(mfrow = c(2,3),oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0), mar = c(4, 4, 1, 1))
plot_clusters(loessed_df = uniform_data[[2]],
              k=6)
mtext("Uniform Age Distribution",outer=T, line=0, cex = 1.25)
dev.off()

jpeg("figs/gaussian_trajectories_yscale2.jpeg",width=6,height=6,units="in",res=300)
par(mfrow = c(2,3),oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0), mar = c(4, 4, 1, 1))
plot_clusters(loessed_df = gaussian_data[[2]],
              k=6)
mtext("Gaussian Age Distribution",outer=T, line=0, cex = 1.25)
dev.off()

jpeg("figs/gaussian_mixture_trajectories_yscale2.jpeg",width=6,height=6,units="in",res=300)
par(mfrow = c(2,3),oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0), mar = c(4, 4, 1, 1))
plot_clusters(loessed_df = gaussian_mixture_data[[2]],
              k=6)
mtext("Gaussian Mixture Age Distribution",outer=T, line=0, cex = 1.25)
dev.off()

jpeg("figs/ipop_trajectories_yscale2.jpeg",width=6,height=6,units="in",res=300)
par(mfrow = c(2,3),oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0), mar = c(4, 4, 1, 1))
plot_clusters(loessed_df = ipop_data[[2]],
              k=6)
mtext("iPOP Age Distribution",outer=T, line=0, cex = 1.25)
dev.off()
```
